products.name: Onboarding Accelerator — Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps — Commercial
products.short_description: Stand up Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps fast and correctly — a guided onboarding accelerator that gets cloud app security / CASB live and validated in a pilot ring.
products.description:
Stand up Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps fast and correctly — a guided onboarding accelerator that gets cloud app security / CASB live and validated in a pilot ring.

Turning on Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps without a plan leaves gaps, noise, and half-onboarded assets. This accelerator onboards Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps end to end: connect the app connectors and API integrations, turn on Cloud Discovery (log collector / Defender for Endpoint feed), configure app governance and OAuth app policies, set session and access policies via Conditional Access App Control, and validate — piloted first, validated, then expanded, so cloud app security / CASB is actually working and monitored.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • connect the app connectors and API integrations
  • turn on Cloud Discovery (log collector / Defender for Endpoint feed)
  • configure app governance and OAuth app policies
  • set session and access policies via Conditional Access App Control
  • and validate

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

A validated, monitored Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps deployment delivering cloud app security / CASB — onboarded in a ring and expanded with confidence, not a half-configured console.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • MCAONB-Discovery.ps1 — read-only readiness for onboarding Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps
    • MCAONB-Hunt.ps1 — run the cloud-app signal validation KQL to confirm connectors and discovery
    • MCAONB-Report.ps1 — coverage report for Defender for Cloud Apps: risky OAuth apps, policy
    • MCAONB-ScopePolicy.ps1 — scope the Conditional Access App Control policy to the MDCA pilot
    • MCAONB-Validate.ps1 — targeted validation of Defender for Cloud Apps onboarding

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all five PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
